Gumroad and Paddle, for instance, offer a range of features that make them appealing to creators, including customizable storefronts, analytics, and marketing tools. However, when it comes to countries with payment restrictions, these platforms fall short. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a comprehensive solution that includes Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This infrastructure stack gives creators the freedom to sell digital products without relying on Stripe or other restricted platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad and Paddle's lack of support in certain countries is a significant limitation for creators who want to sell digital products globally. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is designed to work in countries where Stripe, PayPal, and other platforms are restricted. With its use of Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments, this infrastructure stack provides a reliable and secure payment solution that's not dependent on specific platforms or regions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, fees, and real costs, Gumroad and Paddle's limitations become even more apparent. Their fees can range from 3.5% to 12% per transaction, and their payment processing times can be slow. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers faster payment processing times and lower fees, with NOWPayments' 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements. This means creators can keep more of their earnings and focus on building their business without unnecessary expenses.
Creators in restricted countries can sell digital products without relying on Stripe or other restricted platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Gumroad and Paddle's approach to ownership, automation, and delivery is also limited. They require creators to cede control over their payment processing and customer data. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) empowers creators to maintain full ownership and control over their digital products and customer data. With automation and delivery handled by Cloudflare Workers and Google Drive, creators can focus on growing their business without worrying about the technical details.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

When deciding which architecture to choose, creators should consider their specific needs and goals. If they're looking for a comprehensive solution that includes hosting, backend logic, order storage, and payment verification, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is an ideal choice. However, if they're just starting out and want a more basic solution, the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) may be a better fit.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.

Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
